_comment: Routes shipped with the app. Every device that loads the app gets these,
without anyone having to enter them by hand.
seedId  - permanent identifier. NEVER reuse or change one: it is how a
route already on someone's phone is matched to this file.
version - bump when the course changes. Devices pick up the new version
on next load, unless the user has edited their own copy.
Deleting a route here does NOT remove it from phones that already have it.
A user who deletes a seeded route does not get it back on the next load.
Waypoint order is the sailing order. Coordinates are decimal degrees, WGS84.
Validated by test/seed-routes.test.js - run `npm test` after editing.
